question: Should the repository adopt the Agent Profile registry direction, and if so, under which accepted RFC number and implementation scope?
rationale: The draft intentionally changes no runtime behavior but proposes future configuration and compatibility contracts, which require maintainers to choose the product direction before the document becomes repository guidance.

options.title: Sponsor and complete the RFC
options.body: Assign an accepted RFC number, complete maintainer review, and open a bounded implementation issue after the design is accepted.

options.title: Request a narrower proposal
options.body: Keep the RFC open as a draft but limit it to the profile-selection contract and defer distribution or serving-preset direction.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Close the draft if maintainers do not want Agent Profiles as an OpenClaw product abstraction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and complete the RFC
recommendation.body: Assign an accepted RFC number, complete maintainer review, and open a bounded implementation issue after the design is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz authored the most recent and most substantive design revisions, making them the strongest routing candidate for the RFC decision.
